title: DNS names on the wire
description:
Encode and decode domain names the way DNS packets store them.

```
encode("www.example.com") -> 03 77 77 77 07 65 78 61 6d 70 6c 65 03 63 6f 6d 00
decode(...) -> www.example.com
"a..b" refused: empty label
```
hints: Split the name at dots with `std::string::find` in a loop (lesson 1.03).
In `decode`, before copying a label, check `pos + 1 + length <= bytes.size()`.
requirements: Each label is a length byte followed by its characters; a 0 byte ends the name.
Refuse empty labels and labels longer than 63 bytes.
`decode` checks it never reads past the end of the buffer.
stretch: Support compression pointers (a byte starting with two 1 bits points back into the packet).
